custodyProfile.uncertainty: No third-party custodian exists: reserves sit in USDD protocol contracts (CDP vaults, PSM-USDT vault TSUYvQ5tdd3DijCD1uGunGLpftHuSZ12sQ, Smart Allocator vault TYyC3kxzMYC1sGKpui79VAzwn992jCA6fN per the issuer API on 2026-07-17) whose governance resolves to single-key accounts documented in the mint-authority review (2026-07-13/2026-07-14). Smart Allocator documentation states the USDD team selects platforms (Aave named) and deploys 'USDD's cash reserve' under team monitoring, so reserve redeployment is discretionary and ongoing; constituent Smart Allocator positions and weights are unpublished. No trust, SPV, segregation vehicle, or holder claim appears in the Terms of Use (2025-01-04) or any docs.usdd.io page reviewed 2026-07-17, so no bankruptcy-remoteness structure is documented. Precedent for unilateral reserve control: roughly 12,000 BTC removed from collateral in August 2024 without prior DAO approval (existing coin notice). TRX, 57.7% of reviewed reserves (2026-07-15), is the subject of the open Clifford et al. v. Tron Foundation et al. class action (SDNY 1:20-cv-2804; discovery hearing calendared 2026-04-28).
